units.en: Treatise 114

units.en: Military 10

units.zh: 訓練
units.en: Training
units.literal: Training.

units.zh: 清代訓練軍士，綜京、外水陸各營，咸有成規。
units.en: Under the Qing, drill for troops in the capital and in the provinces, on land and at sea, was governed by fixed regulations for every camp.
units.literal: In the Qing dynasty, training soldiers, taking together all camps of the capital and the provinces, land and sea, all had established regulations.

units.zh: 而歷朝整軍經武之諭，則隨時訓練，因地制宜。
units.en: Imperial orders through the dynasties to keep the forces fit likewise called for training when needed and for measures suited to each region.
units.literal: Yet the edicts of successive reigns to put the army in order and strengthen military preparedness called for training at the proper times and adapting measures to local conditions.

units.zh: 茲分述之。
units.en: Both kinds are described below.
units.literal: Here these are set forth separately.

units.zh: 其定期訓練者，為領侍衛府三旗親軍訓練之制，鑲黃旗、正黃旗、正白旗每月分期習騎射二次，習步射四次。
units.en: Scheduled drill included the personal guards of the Three Banners under the Imperial Bodyguard Office: the Bordered Yellow, Plain Yellow, and Plain White Banners each held mounted archery twice a month on a rotating schedule and foot archery four times.
units.literal: Among those with scheduled training: the regulations for training the personal guards of the Three Banners under the Imperial Bodyguard Office—the Bordered Yellow, Plain Yellow, and Plain White Banners each practiced mounted archery twice per month by rotation and foot archery four times.

units.zh: 八旗驍騎營訓練之制，每月分期習射六次，都統以下各官親督之。
units.en: The Eight Banners' vanguard cavalry brigades drilled archery six times a month on rotation, with every officer from the banner general down supervising in person.
units.literal: Regulations for training the Eight Banners' Vanguard Cavalry Brigades: archery was practiced six times per month by rotation, and all officers from the banner general downward personally supervised it.

units.zh: 春秋二季，擐甲習步射，由本旗定期。
units.en: Each spring and autumn they donned armor for foot archery on dates fixed by their banner.
units.literal: In spring and autumn, they donned armor and practiced foot archery, on dates set by their own banner.

units.zh: 擐甲習騎射，由部臣定期。
units.en: Mounted archery in armor was scheduled by the Board of War.
units.literal: Donning armor for mounted archery was scheduled by the ministry officials.

units.zh: 春月分操二次，合操一次，秋月合操二次，預奏操期。
units.en: Spring brought two separate drills and one joint drill; autumn brought two joint drills, with dates reported to the throne in advance.
units.literal: In spring there were two separate drills and one combined drill; in autumn two combined drills; the drill dates were reported in advance.

units.zh: 仲春孟秋，登城操習，兵部稽察之。
units.en: In mid-spring and early autumn they exercised on the city walls under inspection by the Board of War.
units.literal: In mid-spring and early autumn they drilled on the city walls; the Board of War inspected this.

units.zh: 歲以為常。
units.en: This was the yearly routine.
units.literal: This was the annual routine.

units.zh: 八旗漢兵訓練之制，於春秋月試砲於盧溝穚，各旗咸出砲十位演放，五日而畢。
units.en: Han-banner troops of the Eight Banners tested artillery at Lugou Bridge each spring and autumn, with each banner firing ten guns over five days.
units.literal: Regulations for training the Eight Banners' Chinese troops: in spring and autumn they tested cannon at Lugou Bridge; each banner brought out ten guns to fire; the exercise lasted five days.

units.zh: 越三年，鳥槍營兵與砲兵合演槍砲藤牌於盧溝橋。
units.en: Every three years musket and artillery units held a joint drill with firearms, cannon, and rattan shields at Lugou Bridge.
units.literal: Every three years, musket troops and artillery jointly drilled with muskets, cannon, and rattan shields at Lugou Bridge.

units.zh: 其春秋季常操，四旗合操四次，八旗合操二次，初冬則分遣各旗演習步圍。
units.en: Their routine spring and autumn drills included four-banner joint exercises and two full eight-banner exercises; in early winter each banner practiced foot battue on its own.
units.literal: Their regular spring and autumn drills: four banners combined four times, all eight banners combined twice; in early winter each banner was sent out separately to practice foot battue.

units.zh: 前鋒營訓練之制，月習步射六次，春秋擐甲習騎射二次，左右翼各分前鋒之半，兼習鳥槍，月習十次，均由統領督率。
units.en: The vanguard brigade practiced foot archery six times a month and mounted archery in armor twice each spring and autumn; each wing took half the vanguard and also drilled muskets ten times monthly, all under the commandant's supervision.
units.literal: Regulations for training the Vanguard Brigade: foot archery six times per month; in spring and autumn, donning armor for mounted archery twice; left and right wings each took half the vanguard and also practiced muskets ten times per month—all supervised by the commandant.

units.zh: 每年秋季，前鋒統領會同護軍統領奏聞，率所屬兵演習步圍二、三次。
units.en: Each autumn the vanguard and guards commandants reported to the throne and led their men in two or three foot battues.
units.literal: Every autumn the vanguard commandant, together with the guards commandant, reported to the throne and led their troops in foot battue two or three times.

units.zh: 護軍營訓練之制，月習步射六次，春秋擐甲習騎射二次，與前鋒同。
units.en: The guards brigade matched the vanguard: foot archery six times a month and mounted archery in armor twice each spring and autumn.
units.literal: Regulations for training the Guards Brigade: foot archery six times per month; in spring and autumn, donning armor for mounted archery twice—the same as the vanguard.

units.zh: 圓明園八旗護軍營訓練之制，月習步射六次，春秋習騎射，兼習鳥槍。
units.en: The Old Summer Palace guards of the Eight Banners practiced foot archery six times monthly, mounted archery each spring and autumn, and musketry besides.
units.literal: Regulations for training the Eight Banners' guards at the Old Summer Palace: foot archery six times per month; in spring and autumn, mounted archery, with muskets practiced as well.

units.zh: 步軍營及巡捕營訓練之制，八旗步軍習步射，城門驍騎習鳥槍，均以春秋操演。
units.en: The foot soldiers and patrol brigades drilled in spring and autumn: banner foot soldiers with the bow, gate vanguard cavalry with muskets.
units.literal: Regulations for training the Foot Soldiers Brigade and the Patrol Brigade: Eight Banners foot soldiers practiced foot archery; gate vanguard cavalry practiced muskets—all drilled in spring and autumn.

units.zh: 內九門，外七門，咸設砲位。
units.en: Gun emplacements were set at all nine inner gates and seven outer gates.
units.literal: At the nine inner gates and seven outer gates, gun emplacements were all established.

units.zh: 每屆三年，隨同八旗兵運砲至盧溝橋演放。
units.en: Every three years they moved artillery with the banner troops to Lugou Bridge for live fire.
units.literal: Every three years they transported cannon with the Eight Banners troops to Lugou Bridge for firing practice.

units.zh: 巡捕營參將、游擊，月考其屬之弓矢，守備等各練其汛兵。
units.en: Patrol brigade brigadiers and colonels tested their men's archery monthly; garrison commanders drilled the troops at their posts.
units.literal: Patrol Brigade brigadiers and colonels monthly examined their subordinates' bows and arrows; garrison commanders and others each trained their garrison troops.

units.zh: 春秋兼習鳥槍，與城門驍騎同。
units.en: They also practiced muskets each spring and autumn, like the gate vanguard cavalry.
units.literal: In spring and autumn they also practiced muskets, the same as the gate vanguard cavalry.

units.zh: 內府三旗訓練之制，月習步射六次，春秋擐甲習射二次，立冬後，內府護軍及尚虞處執事等演習步圍，別選三旗護軍習馬射各技。
units.en: The imperial household's three banners practiced foot archery six times monthly and archery in armor twice each spring and autumn; after winter began, household guards and hunting-office staff held foot battues, while selected guards trained in mounted archery and other skills.
units.literal: Regulations for training the Three Banners of the Imperial Household: foot archery six times per month; in spring and autumn, donning armor for archery twice; after the Start of Winter, imperial household guards and attendants of the Hunting Office practiced foot battue; selected guards of the Three Banners separately practiced mounted archery and various skills.

units.zh: 火器營訓練之制，月習步射六次，騎射六次，馬上技藝六次。
units.en: The firearms brigade drilled foot archery, mounted archery, and mounted skills six times each per month.
units.literal: Regulations for training the Firearms Brigade: foot archery six times per month, mounted archery six times, mounted skills six times.

units.zh: 統轄鳥槍砲兵護軍驍騎各官，按日於本旗考驗。
units.en: Officers over musketeers, gunners, guards, and vanguard cavalry tested their men daily within each banner.
units.literal: Officers commanding musket troops, artillery, guards, and vanguard cavalry examined them daily within their banner.

units.zh: 至合操之日，八旗分左右翼列陣，環施槍砲。
units.en: On joint drill days the Eight Banners formed left and right wings and maneuvered muskets and cannon around the field.
units.literal: On combined-drill days the Eight Banners formed battle lines in left and right wings and deployed muskets and cannon all around.

units.zh: 秋季至盧溝橋演砲五日。
units.en: Each autumn they fired artillery at Lugou Bridge for five days.
units.literal: In autumn they drilled with cannon at Lugou Bridge for five days.

units.zh: 健銳營訓練之制，月習雲梯鳥槍各藝六次，騎射步射鞭刀等藝六次，餘日於本期習槍箭。
units.en: The elite sharp-shooters brigade drilled scaling ladders and musketry six times monthly and mounted archery, foot archery, and whip-sword six times, practicing firearms and arrows on the other days.
units.literal: Regulations for training the Elite Sharp-shooters Brigade: scaling ladders, muskets, and various skills six times per month; mounted archery, foot archery, whip-sword, and other skills six times; on remaining days they practiced firearms and arrows in their turn.

units.zh: 值駐蹕圓明園，左右翼各以舟演習水戰。
units.en: When the court stayed at the Old Summer Palace, each wing practiced river combat in boats.
units.literal: When the court sojourned at the Old Summer Palace, left and right wings each practiced naval combat in boats.

units.zh: 旗營校閱之時，自七月開操至次年四月，設教場於九門外，將軍、都統、副都統掌校閱騎射槍砲之事，第其優劣，以為賞罰。
units.en: Provincial banner inspections ran from the seventh month through the following April on drill grounds outside the city gates; generals and banner commanders reviewed archery, firearms, and artillery and ranked men for rewards or penalties.
units.literal: When banner camps held inspections, from the seventh month drills opened until the fourth month of the following year; drill grounds were set outside the Nine Gates; generals, banner generals, and deputy banner generals presided over inspection of mounted archery, firearms, and cannon, ranking excellence and ranking rewards and punishments accordingly.

units.zh: 春秋合操，與京營同。
units.en: Spring and autumn joint drills followed the same rules as the capital garrisons.
units.literal: Spring and autumn combined drills were the same as the capital camps.

units.zh: 陸路綠旗營訓練之制，總督所屬為督標兵，巡撫所屬為撫標兵，提督所屬為提標兵，總兵所屬為鎮標兵。
units.en: Green Standard land forces were organized by commander: governor-general's standard, governor's standard, provincial commander's standard, and regional commander's standard troops.
units.literal: Regulations for training the Green Standard Army on land: troops under governors-general were governor-general's standard troops; under governors, governor's standard troops; under provincial commanders-in-chief, provincial standard troops; under regional commanders, garrison standard troops.

units.zh: 每歲秋季霜降日，先期各營將弁肅伍赴教場，設軍幕。
units.en: Each year on Frost Descent in autumn, officers assembled their companies at the drill ground and pitched camp beforehand.
units.literal: Each year on the Frost Descent day of autumn, in advance officers of each camp assembled their companies and went to the drill ground, erecting military tents.

units.zh: 屆時軍士擐甲列陣，中軍建大纛於場中，統兵大臣於將台上傳令合操，中軍揚旗麾眾，台下舉砲三，軍中鳴角伐鼓，步騎甲士列隊行陣，施放火槍，連環無間，如京營之制。
units.en: On the day itself, armored troops formed ranks around a central banner; the commanding officer on the review platform ordered a joint drill; signal flags and three cannon shots opened the exercise; horns and drums marked the advance as infantry and cavalry fired muskets in rolling volleys, following the capital model.
units.literal: When the day came, soldiers donned armor and formed battle lines; the central army raised a great banner in the middle of the field; the commander on the general's platform transmitted orders for combined drill; the central army raised flags to command the host; below the platform three cannon were fired; in the army horns sounded and drums beat; foot and cavalry in armor formed ranks and maneuvered, firing muskets in continuous volleys without pause, as in the capital camps' regulations.

units.zh: 若長矛、藤牌、扁刀、短刀之屬，各因其地之宜，以教士卒，咸有成法。
units.en: Long spears, rattan shields, and various blades were taught by established methods suited to each region.
units.literal: As for long spears, rattan shields, single-edged swords, short swords, and the like, each according to what suited the locality was used to train the soldiers—all had established methods.

units.zh: 閱竟，試材官將士騎射技勇，申明賞罰，犒軍，釋甲歸伍。
units.en: After the review they tested officers and men in archery and martial skill, announced rewards and punishments, feasted the troops, and sent them back to camp out of armor.
units.literal: When the inspection ended, they tested officers and soldiers of talent in mounted archery and martial skill, announced rewards and punishments, feasted the troops, removed armor, and returned to their companies.

units.zh: 漕運總督標、河道總督標訓練之制，咸與京營同，各營將弁率其所屬，按日督練。
units.en: The grain transport and river conservancy standards followed capital regulations, with camp officers supervising daily drill.
units.literal: Regulations for training the standards of the Grain Transport governor-general and the River conservancy governor-general were all the same as the capital camps; officers of each camp led their subordinates and supervised drill daily.

units.zh: 八旗水師營訓練之制，每年春秋二季，將軍、都統、副都統督率官兵，分駕戰艦，奉天、福建、浙江、廣東水師，各赴海口，齊齊哈爾、墨爾根、江寧省水師，各赴江面，天津水師赴海口洋面。
units.en: Each spring and autumn banner naval commanders led their crews to sea or river: Fengtian, Fujian, Zhejiang, and Guangdong fleets to the estuaries; Qiqihar, Mergen, and Jiangning fleets to the rivers; Tianjin to the estuary and open water.
units.literal: Regulations for training the Eight Banners' naval camps: each spring and autumn, generals, banner generals, and deputy banner generals led officers and soldiers, each manning warships separately; Fengtian, Fujian, Zhejiang, and Guangdong naval forces each went to the estuary; Qiqihar, Mergen, and Jiangning provincial naval forces each went to the river surface; Tianjin naval forces went to the estuary and open sea.

units.zh: 每年自四月至八月，於潮平風順時，張帆起碇，列陣出洋，以次鳴砲操演，餘日各率所屬講習水務。
units.en: From the fourth through the eighth month, when tides and winds allowed, they sailed out in formation and fired cannon in sequence; on other days commanders instructed their men in seamanship.
units.literal: Each year from the fourth to the eighth month, when tides were calm and winds favorable, they set sail, weighed anchor, formed lines, and went out to sea; cannon were fired in sequence for drill; on other days each led his subordinates to study naval affairs.

units.zh: 其綠旗水師營，有內河水師、江海水師，出洋會哨，信候各省不同。
units.en: Green Standard naval forces included river and coastal fleets; patrol seasons and signals varied by province.
units.literal: The Green Standard naval camps included inland-river and coastal-river naval forces; going out to sea for joint patrol, the seasons and signals differed by province.

units.zh: 每歲春秋之季，乘艦列陣，揚帆駛風，鳴角發砲，操演咸如軍律。
units.en: Each spring and autumn they put to sea in formation, set sail, sounded horns, fired guns, and drilled by full military rule.
units.literal: Each spring and autumn they boarded ships, formed lines, set sail and rode the wind, sounded horns and fired cannon—all drill followed military regulations.

units.zh: 其隨時訓練者，天聰七年，太宗始舉大閱之典。
units.en: Ad hoc training began when the Taizong held the first grand inspection in Tiancong 7.
units.literal: Among those trained at irregular times: in the seventh year of Tiancong, the Taizong first held the grand inspection ceremony.

units.zh: 八旗護軍、漢軍馬步、滿洲步軍咸集。
units.en: Banner guards, Han-banner horse and foot, and Manchu infantry all assembled.
units.literal: Eight Banners guards, Chinese-banner cavalry and infantry, and Manchu foot soldiers all assembled.

units.zh: 分八旗為左右翼，漢軍、滿洲步兵為二營，四方環立，前設紅衣砲三十位。
units.en: The Eight Banners formed left and right wings; Han and Manchu infantry formed two camps in a square ring, with thirty red-coated guns in front.
units.literal: The Eight Banners were divided into left and right wings; Chinese-banner and Manchu infantry formed two camps; they stood in a ring on four sides; thirty red-coated cannon were placed in front.

units.zh: 上擐甲乘馬，諸貝勒率護軍如對嚴敵，親軍為後盾。
units.en: The sovereign donned armor and rode; princes led the guards as if facing a real enemy, with the personal guard in reserve.
units.literal: The sovereign donned armor and mounted; the princes led the guards as against a formidable foe; the personal guard formed the rear shield.

units.zh: 傳令聞砲而進，聞蒙古角聲而退。
units.en: Orders called for advance at the cannon signal and withdrawal at the Mongol horn.
units.literal: Orders were transmitted: advance on hearing cannon, withdraw on hearing the Mongol horn.

units.zh: 次漢軍馬步，次滿洲步軍，進攻砲軍。
units.en: Han-banner horse and foot advanced next, then Manchu infantry, to assault the artillery line.
units.literal: Next the Chinese-banner cavalry and infantry, then the Manchu foot soldiers, advanced to attack the artillery corps.

units.zh: 大閱禮成。
units.en: The grand inspection concluded.
units.literal: The grand inspection ceremony was completed.

units.zh: 嚴申退後之令。
units.en: Strict orders against straggling were issued.
units.literal: Orders against falling behind were strictly reiterated.

units.zh: 崇德八年，大閱於瀋陽北郊，前列漢軍砲手，次滿洲步兵、蒙古步兵，次騎兵，次守城應援兵，次守城砲兵，綿亙二十里，聞砲合戰。
units.en: In Chongde 8 a grand inspection at Shenyang's northern suburbs arrayed Han gunners in front, then Manchu and Mongol infantry, cavalry, relief troops, and garrison artillery along twenty li; at the cannon signal all engaged.
units.literal: In the eighth year of Chongde, a grand inspection was held in the northern suburbs of Shenyang: in front were Chinese-banner gunners, then Manchu infantry, Mongol infantry, then cavalry, then city-defense relief troops, then city-defense artillery—the line stretched twenty li; on hearing cannon they engaged in combined battle.

units.zh: 上親臨簡閱，步伐止齊，軍容整肅。
units.en: The sovereign inspected in person; the troops marched and halted in perfect order.
units.literal: The sovereign personally came to inspect; steps and halts were uniform; military bearing was orderly.

units.zh: 順治七年，誡各將領勿以太平而忘武備，弓馬務造精良。
units.en: In Shunzhi 7 commanders were warned not to neglect arms in peacetime and to keep bows and horses in top condition.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Shunzhi, all commanders were admonished not to forget military preparedness because of peace; bows and horses must be made excellent.

units.zh: 十一年，定每年閱操賞銀之制。
units.en: In year 11 annual silver rewards for drill inspection were fixed.
units.literal: In the eleventh year, regulations were fixed for annual silver rewards for drill inspection.

units.zh: 定騎射各兵分期演習之制。
units.en: Mounted-archery drill on a rotating schedule was regulated.
units.literal: Regulations were fixed for mounted-archery troops to practice by rotation in stages.

units.zh: 定督、撫、提、鎮獎賞優等弁兵之制。
units.en: Rules were set for provincial commanders to reward outstanding officers and men.
units.literal: Regulations were fixed for governors-general, governors, provincial commanders, and regional commanders to reward superior officers and soldiers.

units.zh: 康熙十一年，令各省營伍，須武職大員巡察。
units.en: In Kangxi 11 every provincial camp was ordered inspected by senior military officers.
units.literal: In the eleventh year of Kangxi, it was ordered that camp units in each province must be inspected by high military officials.

units.zh: 嗣後各鎮臣以巡察之期上聞，不得擾累各營。
units.en: Thereafter garrison commanders reported inspection dates to the throne and were forbidden to burden the camps.
units.literal: Thereafter each garrison commander reported inspection dates to the throne and must not harass or burden the camps.

units.zh: 十二年，以漢軍不能騎射者甚多，每旗宜增練火器。
units.en: In year 12, with many Han-banner men unable to ride and shoot, each banner was told to add firearms training.
units.literal: In the twelfth year, because many Chinese-banner troops could not ride and shoot, each banner should increase firearms training.

units.zh: 尋議八旗漢軍驍騎，每佐領下，增鳥槍兵十八名。
units.en: Soon each Han-banner vanguard company captain was allotted eighteen additional musketeers.
units.literal: Soon it was decided that for Eight Banners Chinese-banner vanguard cavalry, under each company captain eighteen musket soldiers were added.

units.zh: 十六年，令各營於安營駐宿之道，馳騁奔走之勞，皆須習練，不得僅拘操演成法，直省提、鎮，每歲督選標兵行圍，以習勞苦。
units.en: In year 16 camps were ordered to train for marching, camping, and hard riding, not only set drills; provincial commanders each year led standard troops on battue to build endurance.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year, it was ordered that all camps must practice the labors of pitching camp, lodging on the march, galloping, and running—must not be confined only to established drill methods; in the provinces, provincial and garrison commanders each year supervised selection of standard troops for battue to practice hardship.

units.zh: 十九年，定每年演放紅衣大砲之期。
units.en: In year 19 the annual schedule for firing red-coated great guns was fixed.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year, the annual period for firing red-coated great cannon was fixed.

units.zh: 二十八年，定演砲之制。
units.en: In year 28 artillery drill regulations were fixed.
units.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, regulations for artillery drill were fixed.

units.zh: 每年九月朔，八旗各運大砲十位至盧溝橋西，設槍營、砲營各一，都統率參領、佐領、散秩官、驍騎砲手咸往。
units.en: Each year on the first day of the ninth month every banner brought ten great guns west of Lugou Bridge and set up musket and artillery camps, with the banner general and all relevant officers attending.
units.literal: Each year on the first day of the ninth month, each banner transported ten great cannon to the west of Lugou Bridge, establishing one musket camp and one artillery camp; the banner general led company captains, assistant captains, officers without regular posts, vanguard gunners—all went.

units.zh: 工部修砲車，治火藥。
units.en: The Board of Works repaired gun carriages and supplied powder.
units.literal: The Board of Works repaired gun carriages and prepared gunpowder.

units.zh: 日演百出，及進步連環槍砲。
units.en: Each day they fired a hundred rounds or more and practiced advancing continuous musket and cannon fire.
units.literal: Each day they drilled one hundred rounds and more, and advancing continuous volleys of muskets and cannon.

units.zh: 越十日開操。
units.en: After ten days the formal drill began.
units.literal: After ten days drill opened.

units.zh: 太常寺奏簡都統承祭，兵部奏簡兵部大臣驗操。
units.en: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices nominated a banner general for the rite; the Board of War nominated a minister to inspect the drill.
units.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices memorialized to select a banner general to preside at the sacrifice; the Board of War memorialized to select a Board minister to inspect the drill.

units.zh: 各旗演砲十齣，記中的之數。
units.en: Each banner fired ten artillery rounds and recorded hits.
units.literal: Each banner fired cannon in ten rounds, recording the number of hits.

units.zh: 即於砲場合隊操演，嚴鼓而進，鳴金而止，槍砲均演九進十連環，鳴螺收陣還營。
units.en: They then drilled by company on the gun ground—drums to advance, gongs to halt—firing nine advances and ten rolling volleys before the conch recalled them to camp.
units.literal: Then on the artillery field they drilled in companies: strict drums to advance, sounding gongs to halt; muskets and cannon all drilled nine advances and ten continuous volleys; conch shells sounded to withdraw the formation and return to camp.

units.zh: 三十年，定春操之制。
units.en: In year 30 spring drill regulations were fixed.
units.literal: In the thirtieth year, regulations for spring drill were fixed.

units.zh: 每旗出砲十位，火器營兵千五百名。
units.en: Each banner fielded ten guns and fifteen hundred firearms brigade troops.
units.literal: Each banner brought out ten cannon and one thousand five hundred firearms brigade soldiers.

units.zh: 漢軍每旗出砲十位，鳥槍兵千五百名。
units.en: Each Han-banner contingent brought ten guns and fifteen hundred musketeers.
units.literal: Each Chinese-banner banner brought out ten cannon and one thousand five hundred musket soldiers.

units.zh: 每佐領下之護軍鳥槍兵、護軍驍騎，每參領下之散秩官、驍騎校，及前鋒參領、護軍參領、侍衛等，更番以從。
units.en: Guards musketeers and vanguard cavalry under company captains, assorted officers and lieutenants under battalion captains, and vanguard, guards, and bodyguard officers rotated in attendance.
units.literal: Guards musket soldiers and guards vanguard cavalry under each company captain, officers without regular posts and vanguard lieutenants under each battalion captain, and vanguard battalion captains, guards battalion captains, bodyguards, and others took turns to follow.

units.zh: 既成列，演放鳥槍，鳴螺進兵，至所指處，分兵殿後而歸。
units.en: Once formed, they fired muskets, advanced at the conch to the mark, then detached a rear guard and withdrew.
units.literal: Once ranks were formed, they fired muskets; conch shells sounded to advance; reaching the designated place, they divided troops to cover the rear and returned.

units.zh: 五十年，定火器營合操陣式。
units.en: In year 50 the firearms brigade's joint drill formation was fixed.
units.literal: In the fiftieth year, the combined-drill formation of the Firearms Brigade was fixed.

units.zh: 八旗砲兵、鳥槍兵，護軍驍騎，分立十六營。
units.en: Banner artillery, musketeers, guards, and vanguard cavalry were arrayed in sixteen camps.
units.literal: Eight Banners artillery, musket troops, guards, and vanguard cavalry were divided into sixteen camps.

units.zh: 中列鑲黃、正黃二旗，次六旗，按左右翼列隊，將台在中，兩翼各建令纛為表。
units.en: The Bordered and Plain Yellow Banners stood in the center, then the other six banners in left and right wings around a central command platform, each wing flying a command banner.
units.literal: In the center were arrayed the Bordered Yellow and Plain Yellow Banners, then the six other banners; lines were formed according to left and right wings; the command platform was in the center; each wing raised a command banner as a marker.

units.zh: 每旗鳥槍護軍在前，次砲兵，次鳥槍兵，次驍騎。
units.en: Each banner lined up musket guards, then gunners, musketeers, and vanguard cavalry.
units.literal: In each banner: musket guards in front, then artillery, then musket troops, then vanguard cavalry.

units.zh: 台下鳴海螺者三，以次整械結隊出營。
units.en: Three conch blasts from the platform sent them to arms; companies filed out in order.
units.literal: Below the platform the conch sounded three times; in sequence they readied weapons, formed companies, and left camp.

units.zh: 施號槍三，台下及陣內海螺遞鳴，乃開陣演槍砲九次至十次，砲與鳥槍連環無間。
units.en: Three signal guns and answering conches opened the drill; muskets and cannon then fired nine to ten rolling volleys without a break.
units.literal: Three signal guns were fired; conches below the platform and within the formation sounded in relay; then the formation opened and muskets and cannon were drilled nine to ten times; cannon and muskets fired in continuous volleys without pause.

units.zh: 雍正四年，改定盧溝橋演槍砲為三年一次，均演一月。
units.en: In Yongzheng 4 Lugou Bridge firearms and artillery drill was set to once every three years for one month.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Yongzheng, firing muskets and cannon at Lugou Bridge was changed to once every three years, each exercise lasting one month.

units.zh: 兵校等火藥器用，由工部預儲。
units.en: The Board of Works supplied powder and equipment in advance.
units.literal: Gunpowder and equipment for soldiers and officers were stored in advance by the Board of Works.

units.zh: 五年，以滿洲夙重騎射，不可專習鳥槍而廢弓矢，有馬上槍箭熟習者，勉以優等。
units.en: In year 5, since Manchus had always prized mounted archery, they were forbidden to drop the bow for muskets alone; men skilled in mounted musket and bow work were graded superior.
units.literal: In the fifth year, because Manchus had long valued mounted archery, they could not specialize in muskets alone and abandon bow and arrow; those skilled in mounted musket and arrow were encouraged with superior grades.

units.zh: 七年，以直隸營汛多演空槍，通飭直省將帥，令各營以鉛子演准。
units.en: In year 7, with many Zhili posts firing blanks, all provincial commanders were ordered to drill with live shot for accuracy.
units.literal: In the seventh year, because many garrisons in Zhili drilled with blank fire, an order was sent to all provincial commanders in the provinces to require each camp to drill with lead shot for accuracy.

units.zh: 八年，劉汝麟建議，漢軍應習步圍。
units.en: In year 8 Liu Rulin proposed that Han-banner troops practice foot battue.
units.literal: In the eighth year, Liu Rulin proposed that Chinese-banner troops should practice foot battue.

units.zh: 尋諭各旗兵於初冬行步圍，每旗行二、三次，統以各旗大臣，步行較獵，侍衛、打牲人等，一律學習。
units.en: Soon each banner was ordered to hold two or three foot battues in early winter under its ministers; bodyguards and hunters were to take part alike.
units.literal: Soon it was ordered that each banner's troops conduct foot battue in early winter, each banner two or three times, supervised by each banner's grand ministers; they competed in hunting on foot; bodyguards, hunters, and others all were to learn alike.

units.zh: 九年，以八旗官兵未能精整，統兵各官，擇不堪騎射者，立為一營，稍優者，別立一營。
units.en: In year 9, with banner troops still slack, commanders sorted poor riders into one camp and somewhat better men into another.
units.literal: In the ninth year, because Eight Banners officers and soldiers could not be made precise and orderly, each commanding officer selected those unfit for mounted archery and established one camp; those slightly better were placed in a separate camp.

units.zh: 每營千人，勤加操練，化弱為強。
units.en: Each camp held a thousand men and drilled hard to turn weakness into strength.
units.literal: Each camp had one thousand men; they were diligently drilled to transform weakness into strength.

units.zh: 又以兵丁重在步行，凡八旗兵給限一年習步，以日行百四十里為率，優者賞之。
units.en: Because marching mattered, every banner soldier was given a year to train on foot at one hundred forty li a day, with rewards for the best.
units.literal: Also, because soldiers' weight lay in marching on foot, all Eight Banners troops were given one year to practice foot marching, with one hundred forty li per day as the standard; the superior were rewarded.

units.zh: 十年，以邊陲用兵，操演加勤，免各旗輪班值日，專習騎射長槍。
units.en: In year 10 frontier campaigns brought harder drill; rotating daily duty was suspended so troops could focus on mounted archery and the long spear.
units.literal: In the tenth year, because troops were used on the frontier, drill was intensified; each banner's rotating daily duty was exempted; they specialized in mounted archery and long spears.

units.zh: 十二年，定八旗漢軍驍騎演習鳥槍之制。
units.en: In year 12 Han-banner vanguard musket drill was regulated.
units.literal: In the twelfth year, regulations were fixed for Eight Banners Chinese-banner vanguard to practice muskets.

units.zh: 春季二月為始，秋季八月為始，各習槍四十五日，本旗四翼仍合操二次。
units.en: Drill began in the second month of spring and the eighth month of autumn, with forty-five days of musket practice and two joint drills per wing.
units.literal: Starting in the second month of spring and the eighth month of autumn, each practiced muskets forty-five days; the banner's four wings still held two combined drills.

units.zh: 乾隆四年，定旗兵合操之制。
units.en: In Qianlong 4 banner joint drill was regulated.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Qianlong, regulations for banner troops' combined drill were fixed.

units.zh: 每年春季，本旗各營官兵，於本旗教場分操二次，八旗各營官兵，於鑲黃、正黃二旗教場合操一次。
units.en: Each spring every banner camp drilled separately twice on its own ground, then all eight banners met once on the Bordered and Plain Yellow drill ground.
units.literal: Each spring, officers and soldiers of each camp of a banner drilled separately twice on their banner's drill ground; officers and soldiers of all Eight Banners' camps held one combined drill on the Bordered Yellow and Plain Yellow Banners' drill ground.

units.zh: 至秋季合各營大操，其隊伍號令，旗纛器械，均遵大閱之制。
units.en: In autumn all camps held a grand joint drill following grand inspection rules for formations, signals, banners, and arms.
units.literal: In autumn all camps held a great combined drill; formations, signals, banners, and equipment all followed the grand inspection regulations.

units.zh: 六年，議准八旗驍騎營步射由本旗定期，騎射由兵部定期。
units.en: In year 6 vanguard foot archery was scheduled by each banner and mounted archery by the Board of War.
units.literal: In the sixth year, it was approved that vanguard cavalry brigades' foot archery be scheduled by their own banner, mounted archery by the Board of War.

units.zh: 八年，令八旗漢軍至盧溝橋演放槍砲，於九月朔為始，演放一月，簡都統大臣監視，日演十齣，兵部閱操之日，每旗各演百出，演畢，合操槍砲。
units.en: In year 8 Han-banner troops were sent to Lugou Bridge each year from the first day of the ninth month for a month of gunnery under banner generals—ten rounds daily, a hundred per banner on inspection day, then a joint musket and artillery drill.
units.literal: In the eighth year, it was ordered that Eight Banners Chinese-banner troops go to Lugou Bridge to fire muskets and cannon, starting on the first day of the ninth month, firing for one month; banner generals were selected to supervise; ten rounds were fired daily; on the Board of War inspection day each banner fired one hundred rounds; when finished, they held combined musket and cannon drill.

units.zh: 其金鼓號令，悉如大閱之制。
units.en: Gongs, drums, signals, and commands all followed grand inspection practice.
units.literal: Its gongs, drums, signals, and commands all followed the grand inspection regulations.

units.zh: 十年，以沿海水師，經大臣察閱，其操演多屬具文，未諳水務，通飭將軍、督、撫、提、鎮，實心訓練甄別。
units.en: In year 10 inspection showed coastal fleets drilled mostly on paper and knew little seamanship; generals and provincial commanders were ordered to train and sort them in earnest.
units.literal: In the tenth year, because coastal naval forces, upon inspection by grand ministers, were found to drill mostly as empty formality and were unskilled in naval affairs, an order was sent to generals, governors-general, governors, provincial commanders, and regional commanders to train and evaluate them in earnest.

units.zh: 十四年，以旗兵習練雲梯，隨征金川有功，凱旋後，別立健銳營，雲梯兵千名為一營，統以大臣，專練雲梯、鳥槍、馬步射及鞭刀等藝，並隨侍行圍。
units.en: In year 14 banner troops who had trained on scaling ladders and fought well in Jinchuan won a new Elite Sharp-shooters Brigade of a thousand ladder men under a grand minister, drilling ladders, muskets, archery, and whip-sword and attending the hunt.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year, because banner troops trained in scaling ladders and performed meritorious service in the Jinchuan campaign, after the triumphal return a separate Elite Sharp-shooters Brigade was established: one thousand scaling-ladder troops formed one camp, commanded by a grand minister, specializing in scaling ladders, muskets, mounted and foot archery, whip-sword, and other skills, and also attending the imperial hunt.

units.zh: 又於昆明湖設趕繒船，以前鋒軍習水戰駕船駛風之技。
units.en: Kunming Lake was fitted with practice boats so the vanguard could train in river fighting, handling craft, and sailing.
units.literal: Gan-zeng boats were also set up on Kunming Lake for the vanguard to practice naval combat, boat handling, and sailing skills.

units.zh: 是年，莽阿納上言，整頓邊省營伍章程：一、步弓均改五力以上，一、馬射與步射一式，一、馬兵騎射宜槍箭二技，一、鳥槍專練準頭，一、槍兵兼習弓矢，一、定優劣賞罰，一、預儲軍械，以固邊陲。
units.en: That year Mang'ana proposed frontier camp reforms: raise foot bows to five draw-weights or more; unify mounted and foot archery; train cavalry in bow and musket; stress musket accuracy; have gunners keep up the bow; set clear rewards and penalties; and stock arms to hold the border.
units.literal: That year Mang'ana memorialized regulations to put frontier-province camps in order: first, all foot bows must be upgraded to five draw-weights or more; second, mounted archery and foot archery in one style; third, cavalry mounted archery should master both musket and bow; fourth, musket troops should specialize in accuracy; fifth, musket soldiers should also practice bow and arrow; sixth, fix rewards and punishments by merit; seventh, stock arms in advance to secure the frontier.

units.zh: 十七年，定八旗漢軍藤牌兵之制，春季與旗兵一律操演，遇大閱及諸營合操，則守護砲位，入隊演習。
units.en: In year 17 Han-banner rattan-shield troops drilled with other banners each spring and, at grand inspections and joint exercises, guarded artillery emplacements while joining the line.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year, regulations were fixed for Eight Banners Chinese-banner rattan-shield troops: in spring they drilled with banner troops alike; at grand inspections and combined drills of all camps they guarded gun emplacements and joined the ranks to drill.

units.zh: 三十六年，令鳥槍兵宜遵定例，於演槍時，檢回鉛子，以勵勤能。
units.en: In year 36 musketeers were ordered to recover lead when firing, per regulations, to reward diligence.
units.literal: In the thirty-sixth year, musket troops were ordered to follow established rules and recover lead shot when drilling, to encourage diligence.

units.zh: 三十八年，定各營增演馬上四箭四槍之制。
units.en: In year 38 every camp added mounted drill of four arrows and four musket shots.
units.literal: In the thirty-eighth year, regulations were fixed for each camp to add drill in four arrows and four musket shots from horseback.

units.zh: 三十九年，以金川用兵，京城之健銳、火器二營，功績最多，令各省綠營習鳥槍兵弁，悉仿火器營進步連環之法操練，不得虛演陣式。
units.en: In year 39, after Jinchuan, the capital's elite and firearms brigades were judged best; every province's Green Standard musket officers were told to copy their advancing volley drill, not hollow parade formations.
units.literal: In the thirty-ninth year, because of the Jinchuan campaign, the capital's Elite Sharp-shooters and Firearms brigades had the greatest achievements; Green Standard musket officers in each province were ordered to drill entirely by imitating the Firearms Brigade's advancing continuous-volley method, and must not drill formations in empty show.

units.zh: 尋定各營槍兵升補之序，以資鼓勵。
units.en: Soon promotion rules for musketeers were fixed to encourage skill.
units.literal: Soon the order of promotion and filling vacancies for musket soldiers in each camp was fixed to provide encouragement.

units.zh: 四十年，令健銳營兵月習槍十二日，定三等為賞罰。
units.en: In year 40 elite sharp-shooters drilled muskets twelve days a month, with three grades for rewards and penalties.
units.literal: In the fortieth year, Elite Sharp-shooters Brigade troops were ordered to practice muskets twelve days per month, with three grades fixed for rewards and punishments.

units.zh: 四十三年，令各省習槍兵弁，仿京營火器操練之法，各總兵於巡閱時，有進步連環精熟者紀功。
units.en: In year 43 provincial musket officers copied capital firearms drill; regional commanders noted merit for men skilled in advancing volleys.
units.literal: In the forty-third year, musket officers in each province were ordered to imitate the capital Firearms Brigade drill method; when regional commanders inspected, those skilled in advancing continuous volleys were recorded for merit.

units.zh: 四十四年，令各省綠營兵習射，以五矢中三為一等。
units.en: In year 44 Green Standard archery was graded: three hits in five arrows ranked first class.
units.literal: In the forty-fourth year, Green Standard troops in each province were ordered to practice archery, with three hits out of five arrows as first grade.

units.zh: 五十年，以綠營陣法，向習兩儀四象方圓等舊式，無裨實用，改仿京營陣式，由提督頒發各標鎮，如式教演。
units.en: In year 50 obsolete Green Standard formations were dropped for capital models, issued by provincial commanders to every standard and garrison.
units.literal: In the fiftieth year, because Green Standard formations had long practiced old patterns such as the Two Modes, Four Images, square and circle, which were of no practical use, they were changed to imitate capital formations; the provincial commander-in-chief issued them to each standard and garrison to teach and drill accordingly.

units.zh: 各營每月定期合操，並演九進十連環之陣。
units.en: Every camp held monthly joint drill and practiced the nine-advance, ten-volley formation.
units.literal: Each camp held scheduled combined drill monthly and also drilled the nine-advance, ten continuous-volley formation.

units.zh: 其堆撥應差兵丁，暇日一律練習。
units.en: Men on transport and duty details drilled on their free days.
units.literal: Soldiers on stacking, transport, and duty assignments all practiced uniformly on free days.

units.zh: 又以各省巡撫標兵，向供給使，訓練甚稀，飭各撫臣實力整理。
units.en: Governors' standard troops, long used as couriers, were rarely drilled; governors were ordered to reform them in earnest.
units.literal: Also, because standard troops under provincial governors in each province had long served as supply runners and were rarely trained, each governor was ordered to put them in order in earnest.

units.zh: 其舊式之藤牌兵，均兼習鳥槍。
units.en: Old-style rattan-shield men all added musket drill.
units.literal: The old-style rattan-shield troops all also practiced muskets.

units.zh: 五十五年，令軍機大臣會同兵部，審定演放砲位步數及懲勸之例。
units.en: In year 55 the Grand Council and Board of War set artillery range paces and reward and penalty rules.
units.literal: In the fifty-fifth year, Grand Council ministers together with the Board of War were ordered to fix the number of paces for artillery positions and regulations for encouragement and punishment.

units.zh: 嘉慶二年，罷水師冬令鳧水習藝，以恤兵艱。
units.en: In Jiaqing 2 winter swimming drill for the navy was ended to ease the men's hardship.
units.literal: In the second year of Jiaqing, the naval winter order to practice swimming was abolished, to spare the troops' hardship.

units.zh: 四年，令水營兵丁一律兼習陸戰。
units.en: In year 4 every naval camp soldier was ordered to train in land combat as well.
units.literal: In the fourth year, naval camp soldiers were ordered uniformly to also practice land combat.

units.zh: 又令新疆屯田之兵，每營分半屯種，餘悉回營操練。
units.en: Xinjiang garrison-farm troops were ordered to farm half time and drill the rest.
units.literal: It was also ordered that for garrison-agriculture troops in Xinjiang, each camp would have half farm and the rest all return to camp for drill.

units.zh: 令各省督撫，修理營汛墩台。
units.en: Provincial governors were ordered to repair posts and beacon towers.
units.literal: Governors-general and governors in each province were ordered to repair camp posts and beacon towers.

units.zh: 督操將、備，加力振奮。
units.en: Drill supervisors were told to redouble their efforts.
units.literal: Generals and commanders supervising drill were to redouble their efforts.

units.zh: 九年，令各統兵官習射以六力弓為度，習槍以迅速命中為度，申明教誡，力挽積習，不得養尊處優。
units.en: In year 9 commanders were told to shoot six-draw bows and fire muskets for speed and accuracy, break bad habits, and not live in comfort.
units.literal: In the ninth year, all commanding officers were ordered to practice archery with six-draw-weight bows as the standard and musketry with rapid accurate hits as the standard; instructions were made clear to break entrenched habits and not live in comfort and privilege.

units.zh: 十一年，令德楞泰等兵丁，以十成之一兼習長矛，其制不得逾丈。
units.en: In year 11 one tenth of Delinqtai's men were to train with long spears no longer than one zhang.
units.literal: In the eleventh year, troops under Delinqtai and others were ordered to have one tenth also practice long spears; the weapon must not exceed one zhang in length.

units.zh: 道光元年，令各軍均習長矛步槍，不得專精馬槍。
units.en: In Daoguang 1 every army was ordered to train with long spears and foot muskets, not only mounted firearms.
units.literal: In the first year of Daoguang, all armies were ordered to practice long spears and foot muskets and must not specialize only in mounted muskets.

units.zh: 是年，楊芳上言：「兵丁於練騎射槍矛之外，加以車騎合步連環三項，融結參合，日操一隊，以五隊更番演習，六日合操為一陣。
units.en: That year Yang Fang proposed: "Beyond archery, guns, and spears, troops add chariot, combined cavalry, and foot volley drill in rotation—one company daily, five companies in turn, forming up every sixth day.
units.literal: That year Yang Fang memorialized: "Beyond drilling mounted archery, firearms, and spears, add three items—chariots, cavalry combined, and foot continuous volleys—blended and coordinated; drill one company daily, rotate five companies in turn, and on the sixth day combine drill into one formation.

units.zh: 直隸額兵，抽練四成，得一萬五千三百餘人，成二百四十隊，按圖操演，以齊勇怯而節進退。」
units.en: Forty percent of Zhili's quota—over fifteen thousand men in two hundred forty companies—would drill by chart to level skill and control movement."
units.literal: Of Zhili's quota troops, forty percent were selected for drill, yielding more than fifteen thousand three hundred men in two hundred forty companies, drilling by diagram to equalize bold and timid and regulate advance and retreat."

units.zh: 允之。
units.en: The proposal was approved.
units.literal: Approval was granted.

units.zh: 二年，以廣東營伍廢弛，嚴飭撫臣，實力練習，不得多立章程。
units.en: In year 2 Guangdong's slack camps brought strict orders to the governor to drill in earnest and not pile on rules.
units.literal: In the second year, because Guangdong camps were slack, the governor was strictly ordered to drill in earnest and not multiply regulations.

units.zh: 四年，罷撤梅花車砲陣式，專習部頒九進連環陣式。
units.en: In year 4 the plum-blossom gun-carriage formation was dropped for the Board's nine-advance volley drill.
units.literal: In the fourth year, the plum-blossom chariot-and-cannon formation was abolished; only the Board-issued nine-advance continuous-volley formation was practiced.

units.zh: 五年，允英和之請，以八旗圈馬四百匹，改撥巡捕營，令滿洲、蒙古馬兵演習騎射，春秋二季，步軍統領會同左右翼總兵簡閱，三年後親臨大閱，八年，令那彥成等回疆增設防兵，籌給餉糈，議定操兵章程，並於喀什噶爾防兵內，抽練二千名，伊犁滿兵亦勤習騎射，由參贊大臣及總兵督操。
units.en: In year 5 Yinghe's request was granted: four hundred banner pasture horses were reassigned to the patrol brigade for Manchu and Mongol cavalry archery, inspected each spring and autumn by the foot-soldiers commandant with the wing regional commanders; after three years the emperor would personally hold a grand review. In year 8 Nayancheng and others expanded Muslim-frontier garrisons, funded them, set drill rules, picked two thousand Kashgar men to train, and ordered diligent archery drill for Ili Manchu under the resident and regional commander.
units.literal: In the fifth year, Yinghe's request was granted: four hundred horses from the Eight Banners' pastures were reassigned to the Patrol Brigade; Manchu and Mongol cavalry were ordered to practice mounted archery; in spring and autumn the foot-soldiers commandant together with left- and right-wing regional commanders conducted inspection; three years later the emperor would personally attend a grand inspection. In the eighth year, Nayancheng and others were ordered to increase frontier garrison troops in the Muslim regions, arrange pay and grain, fix drill regulations, and select two thousand from Kashgar garrison troops for drill; Ili Manchu troops were also to practice mounted archery diligently, supervised by the imperial resident and regional commander.

units.zh: 十五年，以山西滿、漢營伍廢弛，嚴飭閱兵大臣嚴明甄別。
units.en: In year 15 slack Shanxi Manchu and Han camps brought strict orders for inspection ministers to sort men clearly.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year, because Shanxi Manchu and Chinese camps were slack, inspection ministers were strictly ordered to evaluate clearly.

units.zh: 是年，常大淳上言，新疆、湖南、廣東、四川各營伍，日久生玩，滿營則奢靡自逸，漢營則糧額多虛。
units.en: That year Chang Dachun reported that Xinjiang, Hunan, Guangdong, and Sichuan camps had grown negligent—Manchu camps luxurious, Han rolls padded with ghost soldiers.
units.literal: That year Chang Dachun memorialized that camps in Xinjiang, Hunan, Guangdong, and Sichuan, over time grew negligent; Manchu camps grew luxurious and idle, Chinese camps had many false entries on the ration rolls.

units.zh: 由於拔補之循私，操演之不實，以國家養兵之資，為眾人雇役之用。
units.en: Favoritism in appointments and fake drill turned state pay into wages for hired hands.
units.literal: Because of favoritism in selection and filling posts and sham drill, state funds for maintaining troops became wages for hired labor for many people.

units.zh: 請飭將軍、督、撫，力除積習。
units.en: He asked that generals and governors root out these abuses.
units.literal: He requested that generals, governors-general, and governors be ordered to eliminate entrenched abuses with force.

units.zh: 遇剿匪保案，不得冒濫，以勵戎行。
units.en: Bandit-fighting rewards must not be padded, to keep the army honest.
units.literal: When bandit-suppression commendations were submitted, there must be no false inflation, to encourage military service.

units.zh: 允之。
units.en: The memorial was approved.
units.literal: Approval was granted.

units.zh: 並令各州縣額設民壯，一律充補訓練。
units.en: Every county's quota militia were to be filled and trained.
units.literal: It was also ordered that militia quotas set by each prefecture and county all be filled and trained.

units.zh: 十七年，令各省民壯，每月隨營操演，授以紀律，以輔兵力所不及。
units.en: In year 17 provincial militia drilled monthly with the camps under discipline to back regular troops.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year, militia in each province were ordered to drill monthly with the camps and be taught discipline, to supplement where regular forces fell short.

units.zh: 十八年，令盛京滿洲兵各勤操務，遇行圍之時，不得有雇役情弊。
units.en: In year 18 Mukden Manchu troops were ordered to drill hard and not hire substitutes at the hunt.
units.literal: In the eighteenth year, Mukden Manchu troops were each ordered to attend drill diligently; at the imperial hunt there must be no hiring substitutes.

units.zh: 十九年，以四川各營，技疏膽怯，致夷匪日張，特簡大臣，督率鎮、道，親往校閱。
units.en: In year 19 slack, timid Sichuan camps let frontier unrest grow; a special minister was sent to lead commanders and inspect in person.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year, because Sichuan camps were unskilled and timid, causing frontier tribes and bandits to grow daily, a special minister was selected to supervise regional commanders and circuit intendants and personally go to inspect.

units.zh: 二十二年，令天津增兵六千餘人，飭各將、備率新舊兵丁，悉加練習，首火砲，次鳥槍刀矛，輔以馬隊。
units.en: In year 22 Tianjin added six thousand men; commanders were to train all ranks—artillery first, then muskets and blades, with cavalry in support.
units.literal: In the twenty-second year, Tianjin was ordered to increase troops by more than six thousand; all generals and commanders were ordered to lead new and old soldiers in full training—first artillery, then muskets, blades, and spears, supported by cavalry.

units.zh: 遇警則各營聯合南北砲台。
units.en: In an alarm all camps would man the north and south batteries together.
units.literal: When alarm came, all camps would unite the northern and southern batteries.

units.zh: 命精能武員，專司稽察，講求方略。
units.en: Skilled officers were assigned to inspect and work out tactics.
units.literal: Able military officers were appointed solely to inspect and study tactics.

units.zh: 二十六年，令各州縣民壯，隨營調考刀矛雜技。
units.en: In year 26 county militia were tested with the camps in blades, spears, and other skills.
units.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, militia of each prefecture and county were ordered to be tested with the camps in blades, spears, and miscellaneous skills.

units.zh: 三十年，令各督、撫、提、鎮，汰老弱冗濫之兵，抽練精壯，俾各營皆有選鋒勁旅。
units.en: In year 30 provincial commanders were told to cut the old and weak, train the strong, and give every camp a picked strike force.
units.literal: In the thirtieth year, governors-general, governors, provincial commanders, and regional commanders were ordered to eliminate old, weak, and redundant soldiers, select and drill the strong, so that each camp had picked crack troops.

units.zh: 不得以工匠僕役，虛占兵糧。
units.en: Artisans and servants must not draw pay on the rolls.
units.literal: Artisans and servants must not falsely occupy military rations.

units.zh: 咸豐元年，奕山等以伊犁及烏魯木齊二處滿洲營增練鳥槍，擬定考驗章程，並綠營一律辦理。
units.en: In Xianfeng 1 Yishan added musket drill for Ili and Urumqi Manchu garrisons, set examination rules, and extended them to the Green Standard.
units.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng, Yishan and others, for Manchu camps at Ili and Urumqi, increased musket training, drafted examination regulations, and applied the same to Green Standard troops uniformly.

units.zh: 三年，綜各省綠營額兵共六十餘萬人，除徵調之兵，所餘存營者，汰弱留強，定期分練。
units.en: In year 3, of over six hundred thousand Green Standard troops province-wide, those not on campaign would shed the weak, keep the strong, and drill on rotation.
units.literal: In the third year, totaling Green Standard quota troops in all provinces at more than six hundred thousand, aside from troops on campaign, those remaining in camp would eliminate the weak and keep the strong, drilling in rotation on a schedule.

units.zh: 各省駐防旗兵亦如之。
units.en: Provincial garrison banner troops followed the same rule.
units.literal: Garrison banner troops in each province were treated the same.

units.zh: 五年，令健銳、火器、圓明園八旗營，及前鋒、護軍、八旗漢軍營，飭閱兵大臣核實校令，分別勸懲。
units.en: In year 5 elite, firearms, Old Summer Palace, vanguard, guards, and Han-banner camps were inspected and rewarded or punished by merit.
units.literal: In the fifth year, the Elite Sharp-shooters, Firearms, Old Summer Palace Eight Banners camps, and Vanguard, Guards, and Eight Banners Chinese-banner camps were ordered inspected by inspection ministers with verified commands, encouragement and punishment separately applied.

units.zh: 又令僧格林沁等增滿洲火器營操演陣式。
units.en: Senggelinqin was also told to expand Manchu firearms brigade formations.
units.literal: Senggelinqin and others were also ordered to expand Manchu Firearms Brigade drill formations.

units.zh: 十一年，以盛京、吉林、黑龍江馬隊官兵，日就疲弱，飭將軍、副都統，無論在城在屯，一體挑練，可造者多方鼓勵，貧苦者酌量周恤，遇行圍兵數不足，以餘丁隨同操演。
units.en: In year 11 weakening cavalry in Mukden, Jilin, and Heilongjiang brought orders to train city and colony men alike, encourage the promising, aid the poor, and use surplus males when hunt quotas fell short.
units.literal: In the eleventh year, because cavalry officers and soldiers in Mukden, Jilin, and Heilongjiang grew daily weaker, generals and deputy banner generals were ordered, whether in city or colony, uniformly to select men for drill; the promising were encouraged in many ways, the poor were given appropriate relief, and when hunt troop numbers fell short, surplus males drilled along with them.

units.zh: 同治元年，以上海、寧波等海口官兵，延歐洲人訓練，令曾國籓、李鴻章、左宗棠等，酌選武員數十人，在上海、寧波習外國兵法，以副、參大員統之，學成之後，自行教練中國兵丁。
units.en: In Tongzhi 1 port troops trained by Europeans led Zeng, Li, and Zuo to send dozens of officers to Shanghai and Ningbo to learn Western tactics under senior commanders, then train Chinese troops themselves.
units.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi, because troops at Shanghai, Ningbo, and other ports were trained by Europeans, Zeng Guofan, Li Hongzhang, Zuo Zongtang, and others were ordered to select several dozen military officers to study foreign military methods at Shanghai and Ningbo, commanded by deputy and brigade generals; after completing study they would themselves train Chinese soldiers.

units.zh: 又以廣東、福建營伍久弛，飭耆齡、劉長佑等於旗、綠營營內，擇驍勇員弁，習外國兵法。
units.en: Because Guangdong and Fujian camps had long been slack, Qiling, Liu Changyou, and others were ordered, within banner and Green Standard camps, to select brave officers to study foreign military methods.
units.literal: Because Guangdong and Fujian camps had long been slack, Qiling, Liu Changyou, and others were ordered within banner and Green Standard camps to select brave officers to study foreign military methods.

units.zh: 天津練軍亦如之。
units.en: Tianjin's drilled army followed suit.
units.literal: The Tianjin drilled army did the same.

units.zh: 其內地營兵，仍遵舊章，隨時訓練。
units.en: Interior garrisons still drilled under the old rules as needed.
units.literal: Interior camp soldiers still followed old regulations and trained as needed.

units.zh: 是年，令文煜等定京營綠旗兵槍隊砲車合陣之制。
units.en: That year Wenyu set rules for capital Green Standard musket and gun-carriage combined drill.
units.literal: That year Wenyu and others were ordered to fix regulations for the capital Green Standard musket companies and gun-carriage combined formation.

units.zh: 四年，醇郡王等訓練神機營兵及練兵三萬餘人，操演漸著成效，綠營亦就整肅。
units.en: In year 4 Prince Chun trained the Shenji Camp and over thirty thousand drilled men with growing success; the Green Standard grew orderly too.
units.literal: In the fourth year, Prince Chun and others trained Shenji Camp troops and more than thirty thousand drilled soldiers; drill gradually showed results, and the Green Standard also became orderly.

units.zh: 令仍隸醇郡王節制，督操閱兵大臣，一併閱看。
units.en: They stayed under Prince Chun, with drill and inspection ministers reviewing them together.
units.literal: They were ordered to remain under Prince Chun's command; ministers supervising drill and inspection would inspect them together.

units.zh: 是年，令崇厚率洋槍隊千五百人赴畿南，飭天津鎮、蘆台鎮選擇標兵，增練新式洋槍。
units.en: That year Chonghou led fifteen hundred foreign-rifle men south of the capital while Tianjin and Lutai picked standard troops to train on new foreign muskets.
units.literal: That year Chonghou was ordered to lead a foreign-musket corps of fifteen hundred to the capital south; Tianjin and Lutai garrisons were ordered to select standard troops and increase drill in new-style foreign muskets.

units.zh: 六年，以丁寶楨所擬訓練馬隊章程十四條，飭特普欽於黑龍江所屬、富明阿于吉林所屬打牲人內，招募壯丁三千人，遵章速練馬隊，以剿捻匪。
units.en: In year 6, under Ding Baozhen's fourteen cavalry articles, Tepuqin and Fuming'a recruited three thousand men from Heilongjiang and Jilin hunters to train mounted troops against the Nian.
units.literal: In the sixth year, based on Ding Baozhen's fourteen-article regulations for training cavalry, Tepuqin in Heilongjiang territory and Fuming'a among Jilin hunters were ordered to recruit three thousand strong youths and quickly train cavalry by the regulations to suppress Nian bandits.

units.zh: 曾經出師回旗之員，分起訓練，入關候調。
units.en: Banner officers back from campaign were set to train again and held inside the passes for orders.
units.literal: Officers who had campaigned and returned to the banners were separately set to training and entered the passes awaiting orders.

units.zh: 十年，曾國籓建議，用兵十餘年，綠營幾同虛設。
units.en: In year 10 Zeng Guofan reported that after a decade of war the Green Standard was nearly useless.
units.literal: In the tenth year, Zeng Guofan proposed that after more than ten years of warfare, the Green Standard was nearly a dead letter.

units.zh: 查閱江南營伍，約有四宗：曰經制綠營，曰新設水師，曰挑練新兵，曰留防勇營。
units.en: Jiangnan forces fell into four groups: regular Green Standard, new navy, drilled new troops, and garrison braves.
units.literal: Inspecting Jiangnan camps, there were roughly four categories: established Green Standard, newly established naval forces, selected and drilled new troops, and retained defense brave camps.

units.zh: 凡陸兵四十一營，水師十一營，新兵十一營，防勇十二營，兵數實存二萬四千餘人。
units.en: In all: forty-one land, eleven naval, eleven new, and twelve brave camps—about twenty-four thousand men actually present.
units.literal: In all: forty-one land camps, eleven naval camps, eleven new-troop camps, twelve defense-brave camps—actual troop numbers were more than twenty-four thousand.

units.zh: 舊習宜改者，約有四端：一、兵丁應差與操演分為二事，應差以分塘分汛為額，操演以分營分哨為額。
units.en: Four reforms were needed: separate duty posts from drill quotas; assign duty by post and drill by camp.
units.literal: Old practices that should be changed numbered about four points: first, soldiers' duty assignments and drill should be two separate matters—duty quotas by post and garrison section, drill quotas by camp and platoon.

units.zh: 一、綠營餉薄兵疲，宜仿新軍練軍之制，裁兵加餉。
units.en: Second, cut Green Standard rolls and raise pay like the new drilled armies.
units.literal: Second, Green Standard pay was thin and troops worn out; they should imitate the new-army drilled-army system—cut troops and raise pay.

units.zh: 一、舊用鳥槍土藥，不利戰陣，各營宜以次悉改洋槍。
units.en: Third, replace old muskets and native powder with foreign rifles camp by camp.
units.literal: Third, old muskets and native powder were unsuited to battle; each camp should in turn all switch to foreign muskets.

units.zh: 一、水師不得仍沿馬兵、戰兵、守兵之名，各省水師，皆應籌造船之費，以船為家，但兼陸操，不得居陸，外海、內洋、里河水師，器械船隻，力求精整。
units.en: Fourth, end obsolete naval ranks, fund ships, keep sailors aboard with only auxiliary land drill, and sharpen gear for sea, coastal, and river fleets.
units.literal: Fourth, the navy must not still use the names cavalry soldier, battle soldier, garrison soldier; naval forces in each province should all budget shipbuilding funds, make the ship their home, only also drill on land but not live on land; outer-sea, inner-sea, and inland-river naval forces, weapons and vessels, should all strive for excellence.

units.zh: 凡此皆事關全局，請特旨通行內外臣工，合議遵行。
units.en: These were empire-wide matters; he asked an edict for all officials to discuss and implement.
units.literal: All these concerned the overall situation; he requested a special edict sent to civil and military officials inside and outside to discuss jointly and comply.

units.zh: 是年，令長江水師，及外海、內洋、里河水師，均應專習槍砲，不得藉口演習弓矢，致開陸居之漸。
units.en: That year Yangzi and all naval forces were ordered to train only with guns and not use archery as an excuse to live ashore.
units.literal: That year the Yangzi naval force and outer-sea, inner-sea, and inland-river naval forces were all ordered to specialize in firearms and cannon and must not use archery drill as a pretext, opening the way to living on land.

units.zh: 沿海兵輪水師，亦免習弓矢。
units.en: Coastal steam warships were also excused from archery drill.
units.literal: Coastal steam naval forces were also exempted from practicing archery.

units.zh: 十二年，沈葆楨以各兵輪雖分駐各省，而操演徵調必應聲勢聯絡，請飭兵輪統領，躬歷各海口，隨時調操。
units.en: In year 12 Shen Baozhen asked the gunboat commander to visit every port in person so dispersed ships could drill and deploy as one force.
units.literal: In the twelfth year, Shen Baozhen, because gunboats though stationed separately in provinces must link their drill and mobilization in coordinated strength, requested that the gunboat commander personally visit each port and adjust drill at any time.

units.zh: 十三年，李鴻章以八旗、綠營兵，用弓矢刀矛抬槍鳥槍舊法訓練，固難制勝，即新練各軍，用洋槍者已少，用後膛槍及炸砲者更少，可靖內匪，而不可御外侮。
units.en: In year 13 Li Hongzhang said banner and Green Standard old arms could not win; even new armies had few foreign rifles and fewer breech-loaders or shells—enough for bandits, not foreign powers.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year, Li Hongzhang stated that Eight Banners and Green Standard troops trained by old methods with bow, blade, spear, musket, and matchlock could hardly win; even among newly drilled armies, those using foreign muskets were already few, those using breech-loaders and explosive shells fewer still—they could pacify internal bandits but not resist foreign aggression.

units.zh: 曾國籓曾擬以新械練兵，沿海七省，共練陸兵九萬人，沿江三省，共練三萬人，計年餉八百萬兩，總理衙門議以制勝之洋槍隊練習水戰，丁日昌議合各省練精兵十萬人，皆以費重未能遽行。
units.en: Zeng had proposed ninety thousand coastal and thirty thousand Yangzi troops with new arms at eight million taels a year; the Zongli Yamen wanted winning rifle squadrons for the navy; Ding Richang wanted a hundred thousand elites—cost blocked them all.
units.literal: Zeng Guofan had once proposed training troops with new weapons: seven coastal provinces together drilling ninety thousand land troops, three Yangzi provinces together thirty thousand, annual pay totaling eight million taels; the Zongli Yamen proposed training a foreign-rifle corps that could win in naval combat; Ding Richang proposed ten provinces together drilling one hundred thousand elite troops—all were too costly to implement at once.

units.zh: 陸軍與水師規制各殊，訓練亦異，水師猶可陸戰，陸軍不能操舟。
units.en: Army and navy differed in organization and drill; sailors could fight ashore, soldiers could not sail.
units.literal: Army and navy regulations differed; training also differed—the navy could still fight on land, the army could not handle boats.

units.zh: 請以現有陸營，一律選練洋槍，裁綠營疲弱之額，加新軍之餉，沿海防營，悉改後膛槍，于海岸要口，屯大支勁旅，專講操練及築壘諸事。
units.en: He asked to arm land camps with foreign rifles, cut weak Green Standard rolls, raise pay, give coastal posts breech-loaders, garrison crack troops at key ports, and focus on drill and fortification.
units.literal: He requested that existing land camps uniformly select and drill foreign muskets, cut weak Green Standard quotas, add new-army pay, change all coastal defense camps to breech-loaders, station large crack forces at vital coastal points, and specialize in drill and building fortifications.

units.zh: 各海口修洋式沙土砲台，置十餘寸口大砲，擇良將勁兵練習，以命中及遠為度，以固海疆。
units.en: He wanted foreign-style batteries at every port with ten-inch guns, good commanders, and trained crews judged on accuracy and range.
units.literal: At each port build foreign-style earth batteries, place guns of more than ten-inch bore, select good generals and strong troops to practice, with accuracy and range as the standard, to secure the maritime frontier.

units.zh: 光緒五年，李鴻章以德國陸軍步隊尤精，得力在每日林操，熟演料敵應變之法，夏秋大操，熟演露宿野戰攻守之法。
units.en: In Guangxu 5 Li Hongzhang credited German infantry skill to daily woodland drill and summer-autumn field exercises in bivouac and attack-defense.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Guangxu, Li Hongzhang, because German army infantry was especially skilled, attributed it to daily woodland drill and mastery of assessing the enemy and adapting; in summer and autumn grand drills, mastery of bivouac and field attack and defense.

units.zh: 其法備於一哨，擴而充之，可營可軍。
units.en: The method fit one platoon and could scale to a battalion or an army.
units.literal: The method was complete in one platoon; expanded, it could become a battalion or an army.

units.zh: 前于海防營內，選游擊等七員，赴德國學習林操及迎敵、設伏、布陣、繪圖各法三年餘，學成回國。
units.en: Seven coastal-defense colonels had studied woodland drill, ambush, deployment, and mapping in Germany for three years and returned.
units.literal: Earlier from coastal defense camps seven colonels and others were selected to go to Germany to study woodland drill and methods of meeting the enemy, laying ambush, deploying formations, and mapping for more than three years; after completing study they returned.

units.zh: 乃於親軍營內，挑選哨隊，仿德國一哨之制，依法教練，漸次擴充。
units.en: They then picked platoons in the personal army, trained them on the German platoon model, and expanded gradually.
units.literal: Then within the personal-army camp platoons were selected, imitating one German platoon's system, trained by regulations, and gradually expanded.

units.zh: 九年，李鴻章始創設水師學堂於天津，習駕駛等藝。
units.en: In year 9 Li Hongzhang founded a naval academy at Tianjin for navigation and related skills.
units.literal: In the ninth year, Li Hongzhang first established a naval academy at Tianjin to study navigation and related skills.

units.zh: 十一年，張之洞酌定海防各營操練章程，舊式刀叉弓矢已無實用，改用新操，一練臥槍，一練過山砲隊，一練掘造地營，一練安放水雷，一練修築砲台，一練臨敵散隊，一練洋式火箭，一練安設行軍電線，一練疾步逾濠越嶺，一練夜戰，一練堅守地營及濬濠築牆一切工程。
units.en: In year 11 Zhang Zhidong replaced obsolete arms with new drill: prone rifle, mountain guns, entrenchments, mines, batteries, skirmish lines, rockets, field telegraph, obstacle crossing, night fighting, and siege engineering.
units.literal: In the eleventh year, Zhang Zhidong set coastal-defense camp drill regulations: old-style blades, forks, bows, and arrows were no longer practical; new drill was adopted—drill prone firing, mountain-gun companies, digging field works, laying mines, building batteries, dispersing under fire, foreign-style rockets, laying field telegraph lines, rapid marching over ditches and ridges, night combat, and holding field works plus digging moats and building walls and all engineering.

units.zh: 是年，李鴻章以外洋留學生回華，於操法、陣法、電學、水雷、旱雷，均有心得，飭分赴各營教練弁兵，並設武備學堂。
units.en: That year Li Hongzhang sent returned students who knew drill, formations, electricity, and mines to train camps and opened a military academy.
units.literal: That year Li Hongzhang, because students returning from study abroad had gained understanding in drill methods, formations, electricity, naval mines, and land mines, ordered them sent to each camp to train officers and soldiers, and also established a military academy.

units.zh: 十二年，張之洞以廣東省駐防營，於光緒六年，選甲兵千五百人，改練洋槍洋砲及陣法，乃裁汰旗營水師，附入步軍，編為兩翼，合陣操演。
units.en: In year 12 Zhang Zhidong, building on Guangxu 6 when Guangdong picked fifteen hundred men for foreign arms, cut the banner navy, attached it to infantry in two wings, and drilled jointly.
units.literal: In the twelfth year, Zhang Zhidong, for Guangdong's garrison camp—in Guangxu 6 fifteen hundred first-class soldiers had been selected to switch to foreign muskets, cannon, and formations—then cut the banner naval camp, attached it to foot soldiers, organized two wings, and drilled formations jointly.

units.zh: 飭製造局移解新式槍砲，增練砲隊。
units.en: The arsenal was told to supply new guns and expand artillery training.
units.literal: The arsenal was ordered to transfer new-style firearms and cannon and increase artillery drill.

units.zh: 十三年，李鴻章以北洋武備學堂學生，於砲台、營壘、馬隊、步隊、砲隊諸新法，咸有成就，飭令回營，轉相傳授。
units.en: In year 13 Li Hongzhang sent Beiyang academy graduates skilled in batteries, entrenchments, and mounted and foot arms back to camps to teach others.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year, Li Hongzhang, because Beiyang Military Academy students had achieved mastery in batteries, field works, cavalry, infantry, and artillery new methods, ordered them back to camp to teach one another in turn.

units.zh: 是年，張之洞始於廣東設水師、陸師學堂，水師分管輪及駕駛攻戰二種，陸師分馬步、槍砲、營造三種，兼采各國之長。
units.en: That year Zhang Zhidong opened naval and army schools in Guangdong—engines and combat at sea; cavalry, infantry, guns, and engineering on land—taking the best from abroad.
units.literal: That year Zhang Zhidong first established naval and army academies in Guangdong: the naval side divided into engine management and navigation-combat; the army side into cavalry-infantry, firearms-artillery, and construction—drawing the strengths of every country.

units.zh: 二十年，張之洞之南洋水師學堂著有成效，加以獎勵。
units.en: In year 20 Zhang Zhidong's Southern Seas naval academy was judged successful and rewarded.
units.literal: In the twentieth year, Zhang Zhidong's Southern Seas naval academy showed notable results and was rewarded.

units.zh: 又於江寧省設陸軍學堂，講求地理、測量、營壘諸術，馬、步、砲隊諸法。
units.en: Jiangning also got an army school for geography, surveying, field works, and mounted, foot, and artillery drill.
units.literal: An army academy was also established in Jiangning province, studying geography, surveying, field works, and cavalry, infantry, and artillery methods.

units.zh: 二十一年，張之洞建議，舊營積弊太深。
units.en: In year 21 Zhang Zhidong reported that old camps were riddled with deep abuses.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year, Zhang Zhidong proposed that old camps had abuses too deep.

units.zh: 人皆烏合，來去無恆，一弊也。
units.en: First, men were a shifting mob with no steady roster.
units.literal: Men were all a mob, coming and going without constancy—the first abuse.

units.zh: 兵皆缺額，且充雜差，二弊也。
units.en: Second, rolls were short and men did odd jobs.
units.literal: Soldiers were all below quota and also filled miscellaneous duties—the second abuse.

units.zh: 里居不確，良莠不分，三弊也。
units.en: Third, residence was uncertain and good and bad men were not sorted.
units.literal: Home residence was uncertain, good and bad undistinguished—the third abuse.

units.zh: 攤派刻扣，四弊也。
units.en: Fourth, extortion and harsh deductions.
units.literal: Levies and harsh deductions—the fourth abuse.

units.zh: 新式槍砲，拋棄損壞，五弊也。
units.en: Fifth, new guns and cannon were wasted and ruined.
units.literal: New-style firearms and cannon were discarded and damaged—the fifth abuse.

units.zh: 營壘工程，不知講求，六弊也。
units.en: Sixth, field works and engineering were neglected.
units.literal: Field works and engineering were not studied—the sixth abuse.

units.zh: 營弁習尚奢華，七弊也。
units.en: Seventh, camp officers lived in luxury.
units.literal: Camp officers favored luxury—the seventh abuse.

units.zh: 若以洋將統之，期其額必足，人必壯，餉必裕，軍火必精，技藝必嫺，勇丁不供雜差，將領不得濫充，此七者練兵之必要。
units.en: Foreign officers should command so rolls were full, men fit, pay ample, arms good, skills sharp, soldiers free of odd jobs, and commanders qualified—the seven essentials of training.
units.literal: If foreign generals commanded them, it was expected that quotas must be full, men must be strong, pay must be ample, arms must be fine, skills must be proficient, brave soldiers must not serve miscellaneous duties, and commanders must not be falsely appointed—these seven were necessities for drilling troops.

units.zh: 所聘德國武將三十五人已來華，即仿德國營制，設步隊八營，二百五十人分為五哨，馬隊二營，一百八十騎分為三哨，砲隊二營，二百人分為四哨，工程隊一營百人，醫官、槍匠等咸備。
units.en: Thirty-five German officers had arrived; on the German model they formed eight infantry companies of two hundred fifty in five platoons, two cavalry companies of one hundred eighty in three platoons, two artillery companies of two hundred in four platoons, one hundred engineers, plus medics and armorers.
units.literal: Thirty-five German military officers already hired had come to China; immediately imitating the German camp system, eight infantry camps were established—two hundred fifty men divided into five platoons; two cavalry camps—one hundred eighty horsemen in three platoons; two artillery camps—two hundred men in four platoons; one engineering camp of one hundred men; medical officers, armorers, and others all provided.

units.zh: 凡勇丁二千八百六十人，餉四十四萬兩。
units.en: The force totaled two thousand eight hundred sixty men at four hundred forty thousand taels of pay.
units.literal: In all two thousand eight hundred sixty brave soldiers, pay four hundred forty thousand taels.

units.zh: 俟操練有效，推廣加練，增至萬人。
units.en: Once drill succeeded, training would expand to ten thousand men.
units.literal: When drill proved effective, it would be expanded and intensified, increased to ten thousand men.

units.zh: 以此軍洋將移練第二軍，俾次第以成勁旅。
units.en: Their foreign instructors would then train a second army until crack forces were built in turn.
units.literal: These foreign generals of this army would move on to train a second army, so that in sequence crack forces would be formed.

units.zh: 是年，胡燏芬建議，新練各軍，宜用一律槍砲。
units.en: That year Hu Yifen urged uniform guns for all new armies.
units.literal: That year Hu Yifen proposed that newly drilled armies should use uniform firearms and cannon.

units.zh: 北洋先練五萬人為大軍，南洋練三萬人，廣東、湖北練二萬人，餘省萬人，操法軍械，務歸一律，以便徵調。
units.en: Beiyang would train fifty thousand, Nanyang thirty thousand, Guangdong and Hubei twenty thousand each, and other provinces ten thousand—with uniform drill and arms for mobilization.
units.literal: Beiyang would first drill fifty thousand as the main army, Nanyang thirty thousand, Guangdong and Hubei twenty thousand each, other provinces ten thousand each; drill methods and weapons must all be uniform for ease of mobilization.

units.zh: 各省應一律設立武備學堂。
units.en: Every province should open a military academy.
units.literal: Each province should uniformly establish military academies.

units.zh: 二十二年，始以新法訓練海陸各軍。
units.en: In year 22 land and sea forces began training by the new methods.
units.literal: In the twenty-second year, land and sea forces began to be trained by new methods.

units.zh: 各省設立學堂，同時舉辦。
units.en: Provinces opened academies at the same time.
units.literal: Academies were established in each province at the same time.

units.zh: 是年，張之洞始裁撤湖北武防等三旗，改練洋操二營，工程隊一營，仿直隸武毅軍新練洋操章程，參用德國軍制，聘德國武員為教習，以開風氣。
units.en: That year Zhang Zhidong cut three Hubei defense banners for two foreign-drill battalions and one engineer battalion on the Zhili model with German instructors.
units.literal: That year Zhang Zhidong first cut the three Hubei defense banners and others, changed to drill two foreign-drill camps and one engineering camp, imitating Zhili's Martial Resolute Army new foreign-drill regulations, adopting German military organization in part, hiring German officers as instructors, to set a trend.

units.zh: 是年，盛宣懷建議，全國綠營兵歲餉千餘萬，練勇歲餉亦千餘萬，凡八十餘萬人，徒耗財力，無裨實用，宜悉行裁撤。
units.en: That year Sheng Xuanhuai urged abolishing over eight hundred thousand Green Standard and drilled-brave troops costing more than twenty million taels a year with little return.
units.literal: That year Sheng Xuanhuai proposed that nationwide Green Standard annual pay exceeded ten million, drilled-brave annual pay also exceeded ten million—in all more than eight hundred thousand men—merely wasting finances with no practical use; all should be cut.

units.zh: 共練新軍三十萬人，就各省情形輕重，定兵數多寡，徵募訓練，悉仿西法。
units.en: Instead, three hundred thousand new troops would be raised province by province, all trained on Western lines.
units.literal: Together drill three hundred thousand new-army troops; according to each province's situation light or heavy, fix troop numbers more or less, recruit and train, all imitating Western methods.

units.zh: 旋總理衙門以各省營伍，驟難盡裁，先就北洋新練兩軍，及江南自強軍、湖北洋操隊，切實教練。
units.en: The Zongli Yamen replied that full cuts were impossible at once and ordered earnest training for Beiyang's two new armies, Jiangnan's Self-Strengthening Army, and Hubei's foreign-drill corps.
units.literal: Soon the Zongli Yamen, because provincial camps could not all be cut at once, first focused on Beiyang's two newly drilled armies, Jiangnan's Self-Strengthening Army, and Hubei's foreign-drill corps for earnest training.

units.zh: 俟裁兵節餉，次第推廣。
units.en: Expansion would follow as cuts freed funds.
units.literal: When troops were cut and pay saved, expansion would proceed in sequence.

units.zh: 飭兩江、兩湖督臣，較准製造局槍砲畫一辦理。
units.en: Two Jiangs and Two Hu governors were told to standardize arsenal guns.
units.literal: Governors of the Two Jiangs and Two Hu were ordered to compare and approve arsenals' firearms and cannon for uniform handling.

units.zh: 又於武昌城設武備學堂，聘洋員教習。
units.en: Wuchang also got a military academy with foreign instructors.
units.literal: A military academy was also established in Wuchang city, hiring foreign officers to instruct.

units.zh: 二十四年，令各省稽察缺額攤派之弊，嚴行革除。
units.en: In year 24 provinces were ordered to root out padded rolls and illegal levies.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, each province was ordered to investigate abuses of quota shortfalls and levies and strictly eliminate them.

units.zh: 至操練之法，宜不拘成格，儘力變通，飭督辦軍務王大臣議之。
units.en: Drill methods should break old patterns; the prince-minister in charge of military affairs was told to decide.
units.literal: As for drill methods, they should not be bound by fixed patterns but strive to adapt flexibly; the prince-minister supervising military affairs was ordered to deliberate.

units.zh: 尋以神機營、火器營、健銳營、武勝新隊，操演嫺熟，賞統兵大臣有差。
units.en: Soon the Shenji, firearms, elite, and Martial Victory units drilled well and their commanders were rewarded.
units.literal: Soon because the Shenji Camp, Firearms Brigade, Elite Sharp-shooters Brigade, and Martial Victory new corps drilled with proficiency, commanding grand ministers were rewarded in differing degrees.

units.zh: 令滿、蒙、漢各軍驍騎營、兩翼前鋒、護軍營，五成改習洋操，五成改用洋槍，八旗漢軍砲隊營、藤牌營，一併改練，神機營汰弱留強，共練馬步兵萬人。
units.en: Half of Manchu, Mongol, and Han vanguard and guards units took foreign drill and half foreign rifles; Han artillery and shield units retrained; the Shenji Camp cut the weak and trained ten thousand horse and foot.
units.literal: Manchu, Mongol, and Chinese forces' vanguard cavalry, both wings' vanguard, and guards brigades were ordered: half to switch to foreign drill, half to switch to foreign muskets; Eight Banners Chinese-banner artillery and rattan-shield camps were all changed to new drill; the Shenji Camp eliminated the weak and kept the strong, together drilling ten thousand horse and foot.

units.zh: 其陣法器械營制餉章，酌仿泰西兵制。
units.en: Formations, arms, organization, and pay followed Western models in part.
units.literal: Their formations, weapons, camp organization, and pay regulations were adapted in part from Western military systems.

units.zh: 是年秋，上親詣團河及天津大閱新操。
units.en: That autumn the emperor reviewed the new drill at Tuanhe and Tianjin in person.
