units.literal: That autumn the sovereign personally went to Tuanhe and Tianjin for a grand review of the new drill.

units.zh: 又令各省增水師學堂學額，增造練船，習駕駛諸術。
units.en: Provinces were also told to expand naval schools, build training ships, and teach navigation.
units.literal: Each province was also ordered to increase naval academy enrollment, build more training ships, and practice navigation and related skills.

units.zh: 二十五年，以北洋各軍訓練三年，飭統兵大臣取各種操法，繪圖貼說以聞。
units.en: In year 25, after three years of Beiyang training, commanders were told to report every drill method with illustrated explanations.
units.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, because Beiyang armies had trained three years, commanding grand ministers were ordered to take every drill method, draw diagrams with explanations attached, and report.

units.zh: 步隊以起伏分合為主。
units.en: Infantry stressed advancing, halting, and splitting and reforming.
units.literal: Infantry focused chiefly on rising, falling, dividing, and combining.

units.zh: 砲隊以攻堅挫銳為期。
units.en: Artillery aimed at breaching works and breaking enemy strength.
units.literal: Artillery aimed at storming fortifications and breaking sharp enemy forces.

units.zh: 馬隊以出奇馳驟為能。
units.en: Cavalry specialized in surprise and rapid charges.
units.literal: Cavalry's skill lay in surprise raids and rapid charges.

units.zh: 工程隊以擴地利、備軍資為事。
units.en: Engineers worked terrain and supplies.
units.literal: Engineers' work was to expand terrain advantage and prepare military supplies.

units.zh: 以平時操練之法，備異日戰陣之需。
units.en: Peacetime drill was meant to ready men for war.
units.literal: Peacetime drill methods were to prepare for future battle needs.

units.zh: 二十六年，鄧華熙於安徽省城設立武備學堂，習槍砲戰陣諸學。
units.en: In year 26 Deng Huaxi opened a military academy in Anhui's capital for guns, artillery, and tactics.
units.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, Deng Huaxi established a military academy in the Anhui provincial capital to study firearms, artillery, and battle formations.

units.zh: 二十七年，以各省制兵防勇，積弊甚深，飭將軍、督、撫，就原有各營，嚴行裁汰，精選若干營，分為常備、續備、巡警等軍，更定餉章，一律操習新式槍砲。
units.en: In year 27 deep abuses in regular and brave troops led orders to cut rolls, pick elite camps for standing, reserve, and patrol forces, revise pay, and train all on modern arms.
units.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, because regular troops and defense braves in each province had abuses too deep, generals, governors-general, and governors were ordered, starting from existing camps, to cut strictly, select certain camps, divide them into standing, reserve, and patrol forces, revise pay regulations, and uniformly drill new-style firearms and cannon.

units.zh: 又令南北洋、湖北之武備學堂，山東之隨營學堂，酌量擴充，認真訓練。
units.en: Beiyang, Nanyang, Hubei, and Shandong military schools were also told to expand and train seriously.
units.literal: Military academies of Beiyang, Nanyang, and Hubei, and Shandong's camp-attached academy, were also ordered expanded as appropriate and trained earnestly.

units.zh: 是年，劉坤一、張之洞等，以二十年來，各省練習洋操，屢經整頓，而舊日將領，於新操多未諳習。
units.en: That year Liu Kunyi and Zhang Zhidong noted that after twenty years of foreign drill reforms, many old officers still did not know the new methods.
units.literal: That year Liu Kunyi, Zhang Zhidong, and others stated that over twenty years provinces had practiced foreign drill and been reorganized repeatedly, yet old commanders were mostly unversed in the new drill.

units.zh: 東西各國教將練兵要旨，約有十二：一曰教士以禮，使知有恥自重，一曰調護士卒起處飲食，一曰講明槍砲彈藥質性源流之法，一曰槍砲線路取准之法，一曰掘濠築壘避槍砲之法，一曰馬步砲各隊擇地借勢之法，一曰測量繪圖之法，一曰隊伍分合轉變之法，一曰守衛偵探之法，一曰行軍工程製造之法，一曰籌備行軍衣糧輜重之法，一曰行軍醫藥之法。
units.en: East and West taught twelve essentials for officers: instill discipline and self-respect; care for men's food and quarters; teach ballistics and powder; teach aiming and lines of fire; teach entrenching against fire; teach terrain use for horse, foot, and guns; teach surveying and mapping; teach unit maneuvers; teach guard and reconnaissance; teach field engineering; teach logistics; and teach field medicine.
units.literal: Eastern and Western countries' essentials for teaching officers and drilling troops numbered about twelve: first, teach soldiers ritual so they know shame and self-respect; second, care for soldiers' lodging and food; third, explain methods for the nature and origin of firearms, ammunition, and powder; fourth, methods for gun lines of fire and aiming; fifth, methods for digging moats and building works to avoid gunfire; sixth, methods for cavalry, infantry, and artillery each to choose ground and use terrain; seventh, methods of surveying and mapping; eighth, methods of dividing, combining, and transforming units; ninth, methods of guard and reconnaissance; tenth, methods of march engineering and manufacture; eleventh, methods of preparing march clothing, grain, and transport; twelfth, methods of march medicine.

units.zh: 各疆臣均應選擇統領、營、哨各官，均切實研究。
units.en: Every governor should pick commanders and company and platoon officers to master these subjects.
units.literal: All frontier governors should select commanders, camp officers, and platoon officers and all study these earnestly.

units.zh: 練兵固亟，練將尤要。
units.en: Training troops was urgent, but training officers mattered more.
units.literal: Drilling troops was urgent, but drilling officers was even more important.

units.zh: 數年以後，非武備學堂出身者，不得充將弁。
units.en: Within a few years only military academy graduates could hold command.
units.literal: After several years, those not from military academies could not serve as commanders.

units.zh: 更請仿英、法之總營務處，日本之參謀部，於都城專設衙門，掌全國水陸兵制、餉章、地理繪圖、操練法式、儲備糧餉、轉運舟車、外交偵探等事。
units.en: They also asked for a capital office modeled on British and French war ministries and Japan's general staff to run national land and sea forces, pay, maps, drill, logistics, transport, and intelligence.
units.literal: They further requested imitating Britain and France's general military affairs offices and Japan's general staff, establishing a dedicated yamen in the capital to manage nationwide land and naval organization, pay regulations, geography and mapping, drill methods, grain and pay reserves, transport of boats and carts, foreign affairs and intelligence, and other matters.

units.zh: 平日之預籌，臨時之調度，悉以此官掌之。
units.en: That office would handle peacetime planning and wartime deployment.
units.literal: Peacetime preparation and wartime deployment would all be managed by this office.

units.zh: 兼采眾長，務求實用。
units.en: It would take the best from abroad for practical use.
units.literal: Drawing together many strengths, practical use was sought.

units.zh: 令內外臣工合議。
units.en: Court and provincial officials were told to deliberate together.
units.literal: Civil and military officials inside and outside were ordered to discuss jointly.

units.zh: 二十八年，設北洋行營將弁學堂，實演戰擊諸法。
units.en: In year 28 Beiyang opened a field headquarters officers' school for live combat drill.
units.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, Beiyang's field headquarters officers' academy was established, actually practicing combat methods.

units.zh: 此歷朝訓練之規也。
units.en: Such were the training regulations of successive reigns.
units.literal: These were the training regulations of successive dynasties.
